breed.appearance: A medium-sized, muscular dog with a short, glossy coat in warm fawn with faint dark brindle striping, a bold white blaze running up between the eyes and onto the muzzle, and a white chest and bib. She has a broad head, a moderately short muzzle with a dark-shaded mask, a black nose, soft drooping lips, and expressive dark brown almond eyes. Her ears are semi-erect rose/button style that flop over at the tips, with pinkish inner ears, and she wears a teal martingale collar with a silver ring.
breed.fun_fact: Boxers are known as the 'Peter Pans' of the dog world because they keep their playful, puppy-like spirit well into adulthood!
